PRIVACY POLICY / A CLEAR VIEW

Privacy Policy for
buying-guide requests.

How your information and choices are handled. Updated 10 November 2026.

Who to contact

Form / Function is this CS2024 project’s name. Alger Goh is the project contact: agoh039@e.ntu.edu.sg. See the team page for all members and their roles.

What information you provide

The form asks what you want to track most (Sleep, Recovery or Activity), an optional first name, ring finish and optional size, required request-processing consent, and an optional preference for future updates. It does not request an email address, phone, address, identity number, payment details or health measurements.

Why and how it is processed

Your choices generate a personalised guide in this browser tab. No form information is sent to a server, emailed to the team, added to a mailing list or shared with Shopee. We do not use cookies, localStorage or sessionStorage for guide entries. The optional name personalises the displayed guide; you may leave it blank.

Separate consent choices

The required checkbox covers local processing to create your guide. The separate, unticked optional checkbox records interest in possible future updates for this interaction only. It does not create a real marketing subscription, and leaving it unticked does not affect your guide.

Retention and deletion

The form resets after guide generation. Your optional name, choices and consent preference remain only in the on-page guide until you select “Start again / clear my choices”, reload or close the tab. This website keeps no submission database. A text guide you choose to download remains on your device until you delete it yourself.

Withdraw consent or request help

Before creating the guide, untick the optional updates box or clear your entries. Afterwards, select “Start again / clear my choices” to clear the displayed result and consent choice. There is no stored subscription to unsubscribe from. Contact Alger at the email above with questions or requests about this project; do not send health or payment details.

Hosting and external links

The hosting provider may process normal website request logs under its policies. Clicking a Shopee link takes you to that service, whose privacy and purchase terms apply. Your optional name and consent choices are never included in those links.

Before a live enquiry or mailing service

Live collection would need a defined operator, justified retention period, secure delivery and storage, access/correction and withdrawal processes, unsubscribe controls and any necessary overseas-transfer arrangements. This version does not operate such a service.
